msg: Pick a colour from the pair of gnomes (such as red or green, brown or purple). If your chosen gnone collects a low number of mushrooms, try another colour from the next pair (note: next pair may have entirely different colours of gnomes, so try to memorise which gnome collects you a high number of mushrooms). Once you identify a gnome with a high number of mushrooms it collects you (usually between 7-9 mushrooms is high), stick to that gnome (usually until the number of mushrooms collected starts dropping to 4-5 or less!). You may observe the number of collected mushrooms going down with time if you keep selecting the same colour of gnome. So you'll know when it's time to switch. Also, trust your instincts. This game is eye-tiring, so by the end I found myself looking less at the screen and more just going with the flow. :) Make sure to identify any patterns you spot, and adjust to them. I'm sure you'll do well. Good luck!
